summary: Sandbach United are set to host New Mills on Monday evening at Hind Heath Road with kick-off at 7.45pm, in what promises to be a competitive clash between two evenly-matched sides both sitting on six points. The Bach have settled into their League campaign with four games played and three already at home, so this fixture marks another opportunity to build momentum in front of their supporters. With both teams looking to push up the table, it should be an intense encounter worth attending.
